text: Hi @aaronbrethorst , I noticed the OpenAPI conformance failures. It seems the schema in openapi.yml is out of sync with the current models. I'll wait for #700 to be merged, then I'll merge main into this branch to fix the test failures. My transaction helper changes are ready to go otherwise.

I've updated the PR to address all your feedback and resolved the CI test failures. Here is a summary of the changes:

#### Addressing Review Comments
* **Reverted Stops/Trips field changes:** Removed the Stops and Trips fields from the ScheduleForRouteEntry model and reverted the handler changes. This keeps the PR focused strictly on the transaction refactor and aligns it with the recent OpenAPI spec update (#700).

* **Error Wrapping:** Updated the withTransaction helper in helpers.go to wrap errors from BeginTx and Commit using the label parameter for better traceability.

* **Restored Logging:** Added operational logging back to bulkInsertCalendarDates to maintain consistency across all bulk operations.

* **Documentation:** Updated the Godoc for withTransaction to clarify the caller's responsibility when a transaction is provided.

#### Fixes & Sync
* **Unit Tests:** Updated schedule_for_route_handler_test.go to remove outdated assertions for the stops and trips fields so they match the updated model.

* **Main Sync:** Merged the latest main branch to pick up the schema alignment fixes.

All CI checks (Lint, Race Detector, and Tests) are now passing. Ready for another look!
